metadata.name: PANGAEA Data Catalog: Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM) and Related Products
metadata.description: A catalog manifest from PANGAEA listing downloadable geospatial data products, specifically Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM) datasets for Antarctica. The resource contains metadata for 4 distinct data files, including content descriptions, filenames, formats, sizes, and download URLs. The actual geospatial data resides within the linked ZIP archives.
